slug: 2026-06-11 Can Africa supply it's own digital infrastructure

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' table of African-owned infrastructure companies lists CSquared, operating in Togo among other countries, with one cable landing station, for the Equiano cable at Lomé; the article gives no date for this, so the article's published date is used.
Data Landscapers' audit of Google says the Equiano cable has been operational since 2022 with landings in Togo, Nigeria, Namibia, St Helena and South Africa.

note: October 2021 announcement describes Equiano as landing in Togo among others, without stating it is in service; no fact taken.

facts.fact: CSquared says CSquared Woezon is the landing partner for the Equiano cable system in Togo, the first landing of the system in continental Africa.
Capacity Media reports that CSquared landed the Equiano cable in Togo in 2022 and provisioned services in 2023, with 3 Tbps on the cable.

CSquared's CEO says it increased capacity at the Lome Equiano landing station for Togocom, GVA and other Togo customers and provided capacity to MTN Ghana and Vodafone Ghana, and describes the firm as open-access.
